title: Presidential board | Hertha BSC
content: Our presidential board in November 2024. His connection with our blue and whites began in 1996 when his father took him to the Olympiastadion for the very first time. A year later, he already got his first season ticket marking the start of his deeper involvement with the club. By 2016, he had joined the blue-and white executive committee, later serving as deputy president in 2022 before stepping in as acting president in January 2024. At the general meeting in November 2024 Drescher, who had passionately supported Hertha from the Ostkurve for years, was elected club president. In November 2024, our members elected her as Deputy President. Since 1999, the Hertha fan has been following the games of our Old Lady from the Oberring as a season ticket holder together with friends, and now he wants to actively shape club life himself as a member of the Presidential board.
